findingsDisposition.proposal: Partial early-return Panel surface, zero decision controls, reachable readonly cached status.

Retain entered original RPC operation+original task identity before invalidate/dispose; pre/post public task tuple/currentness; no readonly or selection/grant reset clears it; all worker mutations withheld until separately reviewed authoritative reconciliation.
Require complete callable state+generation observable capability in Panel/apply; retain original connection owner and fail closed on incomplete stores.

sourceContracts.claim: Successful connected state is published before original generation; loss withdraws generation before state; original state subscribers run synchronously.
Original Gateway generation source establishes readiness and emits reset after generation; loader completion owns start.
Original public logical RPC method owns target/ID/serialization/transport/correlation and returns original endpoint result. No transport-entry or acceptance receipt is public.
Original authenticated cached workerStatus reads diagnostics without worker mutations or catalogue refresh.
Original execute returns execution facts; query returns task and worker only, no absent-execution proof.

identityAndRaceRationale: Run-local token name and original taskRef are captured before any awaited digest. entered/submitted flips only at immediate original public method invocation; local pre-entry rejection retains no unknown mutation.
Invalidation captures entered/unconfirmed state before epoch/revision change and abort, so late catch revision inequality cannot lose unknown operation identity.

Original current selected detail taskRef/version/authEpoch plus nonstale snapshot gates before build, after build and after original reply, covering selectedKey null and transient detail-null selection boundaries.
Current parsed envelope and original operation projection both must succeed before token confirmed; confirmation precedes own task refresh and does not manufacture uncertainty for known success.
An entered old result after invalidation cannot be adopted even if it looks successful; uncertainty remains. Old finally removes only its own pointer, and revision controls busy clearing.

Existing uncertainty cannot be overwritten by another pending token. Common mutation entry plus policy/action freshness/create/execute/capture/finish controls withhold every worker mutation; status/query/result reads preserve uncertainty.
Unknown operation original taskRef survives task switching, refresh, grant invalidation and final dispose snapshot. Separate task cancellation gates are unchanged.
No new reconciliation-clearing API, operation receipt, native helper or backend proof. Marker persistence is limited to original model lifetime; new model/page/process is not proof of absent effects.

narrowReuse.applied: Public design principle only: readonly query does not clear unknown, invalidate retains pending execution. Busy heuristic not copied because it would misclassify pre-method digest/build; no other feature/client copied.

publicRequirements.requirement: In every initial/unconfirmed/offline/setup-not-ready Panel partition, an idle readonly worker status read remains reachable. The partial surface renders zero worker decision or task mutation controls and shows cached/pending/unavailable/unknown facts truthfully. Successful unary status alone confers no setup or original generation authority.

Failures before entering original rpc.call do not imply a submitted mutation or trigger automatic mutation recovery. An entered mutation whose current parsed and operation-specific original result confirmation is lost retains its existing operation identity and original taskRef across disconnect/reset/task refresh/switch/disposal.

Readonly status, catalogue/query/result facts, worker ready phase, task switch and grant invalidation do not resolve or overwrite unknown mutation identity. No new worker mutation or acceptance/grant authority is offered while the model has such uncertainty. No automatic retry or grant is permitted; task cancellation remains independently available under its existing currentness rules.

Late old success/failure/finalization cannot publish worker facts for a new task or clear a newer pending/uncertain operation. Currentness must include selected public taskRef/version/authEpoch and nonstale detail, including the transient detail-null boundary. Confirmed current success followed by ordinary task refresh must not create phantom uncertainty.

All connected decision claims and automatic recovery require original state and generation stores each to provide callable getSnapshot and subscribe, connected state, and an established original generation. Absent/noncallable methods fail closed; readonly cached status remains accessible. No host state/generation, replacement runtime or compatibility shim is invented.

independentDesign: Existing independent 36 and additive 24 families are preserved; future prospective mapping follows source sealing. No independent design was edited or used as an implementation oracle.

unsupportedContracts.partition: required original getSnapshot or subscribe throws
unsupportedContracts.behavior: Approved source checks callable shape only; exceptions may propagate from Apply/Panel. No unavailable presentation or readiness result is attested. Independent US01 needs explicit affected review and separate literal disposition if coverage is required.
unsupportedContracts.actualHostClaim: None; original pinned stores expose stable complete methods.

importEffects.factory: Original lazy require(react), declarations, parser/model/component functions and export object; invocation not performed.
importEffects.apply: Original public setup/task/worker models and subscriptions; original slots/effects/events; scheduled readonly recovery chains when complete original connection is current. No connection.start/reconnect/native/model/provider dispatch is added.
importEffects.workerMutation: Only explicit existing worker model actions may enter original /df-rpc mutation methods; r1 prevents entry while unknown. Synthetic invocation in future controller fixtures requires separate exact approval.
importEffects.emitter: Original scripts/build-client.mjs imports factory and package metadata, serializes factory, invokes vm.Script parse, and writes/renames lib/client.js unless --check. Not executed or copied into a fixture here.
importEffects.injectionsAndExports: Byte-identical existing injection declaration and exported object keys; no public runtime extension.
